aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-beta names, which amplifies both upside and drawdown. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs; strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.
